title: Android recorder track-stop repair
details: Removes the native MediaRecorder.stop call from Android Video Observation finalisation because the real device recording shows that call can freeze the browser UI indefinitely
Ends the camera and microphone tracks instead and lets MediaRecorder flush naturally
Uses a bounded fallback only after the source tracks are already ended, so Milos can continue even if Android omits the final stop notification
Uses one-second recording chunks on Android to minimise any tail loss if the browser fails to emit a final data chunk
Keeps existing Milos learner data, observations, reviews, QR, evidence and document formats unchanged
